content_html:
Getting to Machu Picchu is one of the most anticipated experiences for any traveler visiting Peru.
However, not all routes are the same—choosing the right one can completely shape your experience.

In this complete travel guide, we explain all the available options in 2026 and help you decide which one is best for your travel style.

1. Train (the most comfortable option)

Traveling by train is the easiest and most popular way to reach Machu Picchu.

Ideal for:

  • Travelers looking for comfort
  • Short trips
  • People who prefer to avoid physical effort

Includes:

  • Spectacular scenery throughout the journey
  • Safe and organized travel
  • Different service categories

Recommended if you want a relaxed and hassle-free experience.

2. Inca Trail (the classic experience)

The famous Inca Trail is one of the most well-known trekking routes in the world and offers a truly unique experience.

Classic Inca Trail (4 days)

  • Full experience
  • Combines nature, culture, and history
  • Requires booking months in advance

Short Inca Trail (2 days)

  • More accessible version
  • Less physically demanding
  • Ideal if you have limited time

Perfect for travelers seeking adventure and a deeper connection with history.

3. Hydroelectric Route (the budget option)

The Hydroelectric route is the most affordable way to reach Machu Picchu.

How does it work?

  • Travel by transport to Hydroelectric station
  • Walk 2 to 3 hours to Aguas Calientes

Ideal for:

  • Backpackers
  • Budget travelers
  • Adventurous travelers

It takes longer, but it is also more flexible and economical.

Which option is the best?

The best route depends entirely on your travel profile:

  • Low budget → Hydroelectric route
  • Adventure → Inca Trail
  • Comfort → Train

There is no single “best” option—only the one that best fits your trip.

Important recommendations

Before traveling, keep in mind:

  • Book in advance (especially the Inca Trail)
  • Evaluate your physical condition
  • Consider your available time
  • Check availability during high season

Why is it important to plan your visit?

Because Machu Picchu is not just a destination…

It’s a once-in-a-lifetime experience in one of the world’s wonders.
Proper planning can make the difference between a regular trip and an unforgettable one.
